verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents a hire-and-onboard flow that runs "from offer letter to day one," and employees can enter their own personal, direct-deposit and tax info online or in the app. That covers the self-serve bank-detail and tax-withholding parts of the story. I-9 collection is never mentioned, and the W-4 form is only implied by the reference to tax info. missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection/verification, explicit W-4 form handling, detail on sending the flow to a new hire before start date, independent or hands-on corroboration.
